issues.where: call.md (Purpose and eligibility, ME2, ME3, ME8, ME9) and call.yaml (eligibility.consortium.notes, ME2, ME3, ME8, ME9)
issues.problem: There are direct contradictions in the consortium and eligibility rules. ME3 allows a public university to coordinate, while ME8 explicitly forbids it. ME2 and `eligibility.consortium.notes` allow beneficiaries from any CERV-eligible country, while ME9 restricts beneficiaries strictly to EU Member States. The 'Purpose and eligibility' section also implies associated countries are fully eligible, contradicting ME9.
issues.fix: Resolve the contradictions by either removing ME2 and ME3 and updating 'Purpose and eligibility' and `eligibility.consortium.notes` to match the stricter rules in ME8 and ME9, or by removing ME8 and ME9 to keep the general CERV rules.
